inputs.ad_text_01: A five-second black-and-white historical editorial documentary shot. Fine silver-gelatin photographic grain, neutral grayscale, soft natural light, restrained realistic human gestures, physically coherent surroundings. Locked wide shot, gentle natural motion, crisp photographic detail. No text, no subtitles, no letters, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no split screen, no graphics, no montage, no shot changes. This is an original illustrative reconstruction, not authentic archive footage. A contemporary commercial property developer and a bank loan officer sit opposite each other at a plain desk. The developer wears a simple dark blazer. They review blank loan documents, a small architectural model, and a calculator. The officer hands over a pen and the developer signs one page. Medium wide composition, natural hands, human decision and contract are the main subject.
